description: The chart illustrates bias percentages across three topical categories (Sports, Community, Healthcare) and three contact conditions (No Contact, Positive Contact, Negative Contact), with each condition shown as a stacked bar separating values “Before” instruction tuning (lighter solid fill) and “After” instruction tuning (darker hatched segment stacked on top of the corresponding lighter segment). The horizontal axis contains the category groups ordered left to right as Sports, Community, and Healthcare, with three adjacent bars per group; the vertical axis is labeled “Bias Percentage” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals. In each group, the No Contact bar is light gray for “No Contact Before” with a darker gray hatched “No Contact After” segment; the Positive Contact bar is light pink for “Positive Contact Before” with a darker red hatched “Positive Contact After” segment; and the Negative Contact bar is light blue for “Negative Contact Before” with a darker navy hatched “Negative Contact After” segment; each segment has a numeric label printed on or just above it. For Sports, the stacked bars show No Contact at 45.42 (before, light gray) plus 7.45 (after, hatched gray) for a total height of about 52.87, Positive Contact at 43.65 (before, light pink) plus 8.31 (after, hatched red) totaling about 51.96, and Negative Contact at 50.05 (before, light blue) plus 8.33 (after, hatched navy) totaling about 58.38. For Community, the No Contact bar is 38.08 (before) with an after segment labeled 0.00 (total ~38.08), Positive Contact is 35.38 (before) plus 0.01 (after) (total ~35.39), and Negative Contact is 40.79 (before) plus 0.00 (after) (total ~40.79). For Healthcare, No Contact is 40.70 (before) plus 0.00 (after) (total ~40.70), Positive Contact is 37.51 (before) plus 0.01 (after) (total ~37.52), and Negative Contact is 46.73 (before) plus 0.11 (after) (total ~46.84). The bars appear grouped by topic rather than sorted by magnitude, and the “After” portions are visually indicated by hatched shading and placement directly above the corresponding “Before” portions, with some after segments so small that they are barely visible.
